utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, Vik, the repair drive? I think I heard something about that... Is it this Saturday? I might have an old hammer somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it's this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4! I'm bringing my old toaster, and I think Marlon's bringing his broken blender too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: A toaster and a blender, huh? That reminds me, I think I've got a lamp somewhere that's been flickering for months... maybe I'll bring that too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Opal, are you planning to join the repair drive this weekend? I'm gathering supplies and could use a hand.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I'm definitely planning to be there. I've already got my calendar marked for Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's great to hear, Opal! I'm putting together a supply list with Rosa—do you have any tools or materials you could bring?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Bo! I'm glad to hear you're on board for the repair drive—Opal's got everything lined up, and I'll have my power drill and socket set ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, that's great Jules, sounds like you're all set—I really need to check if I even signed up yet.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Bo—I can double-check with Opal's list if you want. Either way, it'd be great to have you there!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Dane, you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center? Vik's already planning to bring his blender—pretty exciting stuff!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I just talked to Gus about starting with the Smiths' fence. Sounds like we've got a solid crew coming together!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the fence project? That's great too! But don't forget the repair drive Saturday—I'll be there with my broken lamp.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I think we're off to a good start—Noah's offering a hammer, and I've got wrenches and pliers ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hold on, Cleo. I still need a straight answer: did the repair drive actually get the green light, or are we just collecting tools for nothing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It's all set, Kira—I got the green light from the community center manager yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Gus, are you planning to come to the repair drive this Saturday? They'll be fixing stuff for free, and I hear there's a workshop afterward to learn some basic repairs yourself!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Actually, Tess, I'm the one organizing the repair drive! I'll be there with my tools, leading the first stop at the Smiths' fence.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, no kidding! That's awesome, Gus—I had no idea you were the mastermind behind it. I'll definitely be there to help out and maybe pick up a few tips at that workshop.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds great, Quinn! I'll be home in the morning, so swing by anytime after nine—I'll have the list ready.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Faye, I can swing by in the morning too if you need an extra hand with getting that list together.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be wonderful, Sam! The more hands we have sorting through what people are bringing, the smoother it'll go.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Just to confirm, the repair drive starts at 9 AM sharp, right? I want to make sure I'm not early or late.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, 9 AM sharp! I've got the time noted on the sign-up sheet, so if you need a reminder, I can send it your way.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, good — I appreciate you keeping it all organized. I'll be there right on time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I almost forgot about that. Are you bringing anything to fix?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just some old tools, maybe. I’m not sure they’re worth fixing, but I’ll see.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I keep meaning to look through my shed too, but I always get sidetracked. Maybe I'll find something.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard it's this Saturday. I'm planning to bring my old blender to get fixed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm planning to bring my old toolbox—might have some useful pieces in it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's a good idea—I bet they can use whatever spare parts you've got.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'll be at Gus's garage with the hammers and saws at 8 AM.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Leo! I'll make sure to spread the word so everyone knows you're the early bird with the hardware.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. I'll bring an extra saw in case anyone needs one.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do we have a list of what people are bringing? I want to make sure I have the right tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I've got a list! Just a heads-up, the drive has moved to Sunday at the community center. I can share the list with you so you know what tools to bring.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, send me that list. I don't want to show up without the right screwdriver for a job.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Sam, sorry I'm late. What's the latest on the repair drive schedule?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, no worries! The drive is this weekend, starting at 9 AM on Saturday. I'm bringing my tool kit and scrap wood.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I'll bring my spare WD-40 and some clamps. Have we confirmed the final list of volunteers yet?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, Opal, I need a straight answer — is this repair drive actually locked in, or are we just talking again?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, it's locked in — I've already got Jules's tools lined up and a couple of other folks ready to help. We're set for Saturday the 15th at the community center from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, but I've heard that before. Can you tell me who else besides Jules is bringing tools?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So what exactly needs to be repaired? I want to know what I'm getting into before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, Vik's bringing his old toaster, and Sarah mentioned a wobbly chair—it's mostly small household stuff, and I'll have my drill and socket set ready to help out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, that sounds manageable. Do you need me to bring anything specific, like extra screws or a multimeter?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Leo, are you planning to bring anything to the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I've got hammers and saws ready. Dropping them at Gus's garage at 8.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, perfect — I'll make sure everything's organized at Gus's. Rosa and I are gathering supplies tomorrow, so we'll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard about Cleo's repair drive—I'm planning to bring my old toolbox along. What are you thinking of contributing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm bringing a socket set, but I'm worried we'll have duplicates—did you see if anyone else signed up to bring tools?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven't checked the list yet, but I think extras are fine—someone's bound to need a backup.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Well, that's kind of you to say, Bo.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, well, I just hope I can actually find that flyer before Saturday rolls around.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: If you'd like, I can ask Leo if he has an extra copy.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'll head to the shed to double-check the repair drive and grab those extension cords while I'm at it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Hana. I think there's a couple of spare cords in the back of my truck too if you need 'em.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus—I'll take a look in your truck if I can't find enough in the shed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Quinn, that sounds great—swinging by my place first works perfectly. We can go over the setup details and make sure we're on the same page before you head out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Faye, I'm so glad you're coordinating with Quinn—every little bit of planning helps. I've got a box of spare screws and a wrench set I'll bring over later.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, Cleo—a box of screws is exactly the kind of thing we need. I'll add that to the list right now.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rosa, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? They're fixing old appliances for free, and there's even a workshop afterwards!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Actually, Tess, it's been moved to Sunday at the community center—still from 10 to 4, and I'm helping organize it. You should come!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Sunday works even better for me! Can we bring our own tools, or is everything provided?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Oren, did you catch the news about that repair drive this Saturday? I'm thinking of bringing my broken toaster.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I almost forgot about that. Are you bringing anything to fix?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, my toaster's been on the fritz. What about you—got anything that needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Eli! That's exactly the kind of organized spirit we need. I'll put you down for 9 a.m. with a toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Quinn, do you know if folks are still bringing in small appliances at a certain time, or is it just drop-in all day?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, it's pretty much drop-in all day, Rey! But if you can swing by in the morning, that's when we'll have the most hands to help diagnose things.
